candidates.source_conflict: Coinbase report reuses first exploit transaction link for the second 20:43:18 wave and describes an inconsistent time gap. Do not copy it as a second label; resolve from raw chain evidence and another primary investigation.
candidates.population_proposal: BSC CrossChain system contract 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000002000 and TokenHub 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001004, plus matched Beacon-side messages if cross-chain invariants are tested.

common_label_policy: Unlabelled transactions/days are unknown, not confirmed benign. Report actual reviewed-alert denominator; do not infer false positives from all non-attack time.
selection_note: Selection based on evidence and acquisition feasibility only. Final acceptance/exclusion decisions must be logged before comparing monitoring methods. A receipt probe is not proof of complete historical availability.
related_work_correction: BridgeGuard v2 reviewed 49 historical incidents, but section 3.3 describes 22 cross-chain-business-logic attacks supplying 203 labelled attack transactions. Neither 49 nor 203 is the count of independent incidents in that evaluation.
